featured_reviews.review_text:
FRAUDTERS AND CHEATERS
AVOID BUYING FROM THEM

Absolutely unacceptable experience with Hare Krishan Mahindra, Mulund.

I was shocked by the manner in which the vehicle purchase process was handled. I was clearly informed by dealership representatives that unless I purchased dealership-linked insurance, my booking would not be accepted and the vehicle would not be delivered. Despite repeatedly expressing my willingness to obtain a valid insurance policy from an external insurer, I was told that self-insurance would not be permitted.

This was not a case of merely recommending an insurance product. The clear message communicated to me was that dealership insurance was required if I wanted to proceed with the purchase and secure delivery of the vehicle.

The insurance premiums quoted by the dealership were significantly higher than comparable alternatives available in the market, resulting in a substantial additional financial burden. Even after revised quotations were issued, the dealership continued to refuse self-insurance and continued to insist upon dealership-linked insurance.

What makes this even more concerning is that I possess documentary evidence supporting these interactions, including:

* Written chats and communications from dealership representatives
* Insurance quotations showing substantial pricing differences
* Screenshots relating to rejection of self-insurance
* Evidence relating to similar experiences reported by other customers

After reviewing other customer feedback and documentation available to me, I was extremely disturbed to find that similar concerns have allegedly been raised by multiple customers in the past. This suggests that my experience may not have been an isolated incident.

The matter has been escalated to Mahindra’s senior leadership and supporting documentation has been shared with relevant stakeholders for review. I sincerely hope a thorough investigation is conducted into the practices being followed at this dealership.

Prospective customers should exercise extreme caution, obtain independent insurance quotations, insist on written communications, and carefully review all charges before proceeding.

One of the most disappointing and concerning automotive purchase experiences I have encountered.
